preamble.summary: Deuteronomy 3 recounts the defeat of Og of Bashan and the allotment of Transjordan. 4QDeutᵈ preserves vv. 1–14 in continuous text, making this the best-attested portion of Deut 3 at Qumran. 4QDeutᵐ supplies fragments of vv. 18–22.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants. The text agrees with the MT; differences are orthographic (plene/defective spelling). The Og bedstead tradition (v. 11) is preserved verbatim.
preamble.scroll_condition: 4QDeutᵈ provides continuous text through v. 14; later verses survive only in scattered fragments.

variant_notes: The Og bedstead description ("nine cubits its length, four cubits its breadth, by the cubit of a man") is preserved verbatim. Tracks MT.
The Jair allotment notice is attested in two separate scrolls; both track MT.
The mobilization order to the Reubenites and Gadites is preserved; tracks MT.
